mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in total demand (GDPC1) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite sustained quarterly GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC <0.05 over 6-month window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% triggers a positive S&P 500 forward return over 20 trading days, signaling labor market tightness and inflationary pressures.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative when UNRATE crosses below 5.0%, or t-test p-value >0.05 showing no significant effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in federal funds rate (monetary easing) and rising quarterly demand (GDPC1) create a dual expansion signal, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative despite both FEDFUNDS falling and GDPC1 rising, or IC <0.05 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, improving supply conditions (INDPRO) reduce inflationary pressures, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative despite rising INDPRO in the late-cycle expansion regime, or IC <0.03 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) signals a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative despite rising PAYEMS, or IC <0.1 over the 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days, signaling labor market tightness and inflationary risks.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when UNRATE crosses above 6.5%, or IC >0.1 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in federal funds rate (monetary easing) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) create a conflicting signal, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive despite FEDFUNDS falling and UNRATE rising, or IC >0.1 over the 20-day window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, sustained monetary easing (FEDFUNDS decline) amplifies equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative despite FEDFUNDS declining in the post-shock recovery regime, or IC <0.03 over the 60-day window.
